title: Special Topics in History; (Auto)biography and the Black Atlantic: 1700-1865
description: Examines self-writing (autobiography, memoirs, diaries) as an entry point to the history of the African diaspora in the Americas. Discusses how people of African descent understood and represented themselves, in relation to a changing social and political environment. Analyzes the challenges of writing historical biography and the relationships between biography and history. Students conduct their own biographical research into a Black Atlantic figure of their choice. Cross-listed with AAAS398D. Credit will be only granted AAAS398D or HIST338K.
